$comment: ★ THE INVENTORY OF RECORD — SLOW-MOVING FACTS ONLY. Plan, published limit, cost risk, and which probe reports this service's live state. NOTHING HERE IS MEASURED AT RUNTIME. Liveness belongs to scripts/website-team/sentinel/*.sh and to nothing else: on 2026-09-11 infra-status.py carried its own copy of the GitHub and Vercel checks, drifted from the probes within four hours, and reported Neon as UNKNOWN while the probe was measuring 112MB of it. Two instruments computing one fact is this repository's most repeated defect class. If you want to change what a service REPORTS, change its probe. This file says only what is true between runs. EXTENDED 2026-09-11 to cover the fundraising department, which had no infrastructure watch at all despite being the only department with a bill. Rows carry a `department` field so the table can be read per department.
published_limits_are_quotations: Every `limit` here is read from the provider's own terms on the date in `read`. It is a quotation, not a measurement, and the renderer labels it as published.

services.name: Vercel
services.plan: Hobby (plan itself unverified — the project-scoped token cannot read account-level plan data)
services.cost_risk: HIGH — hosting; the largest single billing exposure in the stack
services.unmeasured: bandwidth — account-level, out of the project scope's reach

services.name: Neon (Postgres)
services.cost_risk: HIGH — and the only limit that grows without anyone acting, because Umami writes a row per visit. Three projects share this one plan and the largest is farm-app, not the website.
services.unmeasured: compute hours — consumption_history/account 404s on the free plan

services.name: GitHub — Actions
services.cost_risk: NONE while the repository is public. Making it private starts metering at 2,000 minutes/month and this line becomes wrong.

services.name: GitHub — API & storage
services.cost_risk: NONE — exhaustion throttles, it does not bill

services.name: data.gov.in (CPCB air)
services.cost_risk: NONE — no paid tier exists; the risk is withdrawal, not cost
services.unmeasured: consumption — the provider exposes no quota endpoint

services.name: WAQI / AQICN
services.cost_risk: LOW — exceeding it throttles rather than bills

services.name: NASA FIRMS
services.unmeasured: consumption — readable from mapkey_status, not yet surfaced

services.name: swechha.in (the site itself)
services.cost_risk: NONE directly — but a frozen site is the failure this department exists to catch

services.name: Air / climate pipelines
services.cost_risk: NONE — but staleness here is invisible from outside, which is why it is probed

services.name: Resend (email)
services.cost_risk: LOW — the site sends on form submission only
services.unmeasured: no probe; reading usage needs an authenticated call

services.name: Umami (analytics)
services.cost_risk: INDIRECT — it is the thing that grows Neon storage
services.unmeasured: its counts live in Neon; watch the Neon row instead

services.name: cron-job.org (air heartbeat)
services.cost_risk: LOW, but it holds a GitHub PAT whose expiry stops the pipeline being driven at all
services.unmeasured: no API token recorded for this account

services.name: DNS / domain (swechha.in)
services.cost_risk: RECURRING AND ALREADY PAID — an expiry takes the whole site down and no free-tier care prevents it
services.unmeasured: registrar not recorded in this repository

services.name: Fundraising department
services.cost_risk: NONE for the runtime — but see its paid dependencies below

services.name: Anthropic API (proposal drafting)
services.cost_risk: ★ THE ONLY RECURRING PAID DEPENDENCY IN THE ORGANISATION. Used by fundraising's drafting stage because the commercial API does not train on inputs and that stage sends Swechha's knowledge base. Free-first does not apply here — the privacy requirement bought this cost deliberately.
services.unmeasured: spend — needs an Anthropic ADMIN key, which is more powerful than the API key the pipeline uses and is not on this machine

services.name: Tavily (search)
services.cost_risk: MEDIUM — bills past the free tier and nothing counts the calls
services.unmeasured: usage — no key on this machine; the key is a GitHub Actions secret

services.name: Airtable (fundraising task store)
services.cost_risk: MEDIUM — it is the department's TASK STORE, so exhausting a record limit stops the decision queue rather than degrading it
services.unmeasured: record count and plan — key is a GitHub Actions secret

services.name: Brevo (fundraising email)
services.cost_risk: LOW, but email is this department's ONLY output and only failure channel — if it stops, the department goes silent in exactly the way its guards exist to prevent
services.unmeasured: send count — key is a GitHub Actions secret
